title: QVAC Marketplace: register an inference provider
summary: Register a QVAC provider, then create an escrowed SOL job against an Ed25519-signed quote, complete it, and confirm to pay the provider.
what: QVAC Marketplace is an Anchor 1.0 program for an on-chain AI inference market. Providers register a name, task-type bitmask and QVAC DHT peer id. Consumers later create escrowed jobs against an Ed25519-signed quote. Upstream also has off-chain provider tooling; the hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment.
app_note: The page at /dapps/qvac-marketplace/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/qvac-marketplace/, switch to Devnet, and connect Phantom or Solflare.
try_steps.see: The page lists register_provider, update_provider, create_job and more, and shows program 2R3iKnrn…
try_steps.ran: The lab wallet BP1uwSaT… used the same IDL client.

try_steps.do: register_provider campus-scout is already taken by the lab wallet. Fetch provider GrRvaYzN… (seeds ["provider", authority]).
try_steps.see: After the lab update, name=campus-scout-v2 and task_types=3.

try_steps.do: A register_provider with a 1-byte name, or a second register for the same authority, should fail.
try_steps.see: NameTooShort, or the provider PDA already in use.
try_steps.ran: Both negatives were rejected in tests/devnet/qvac-marketplace.mjs.

diagram: authority --register_provider--> provider PDA ["provider", authority] ; authority --update_provider--> same PDA
innovation: On-chain provider registry plus quote-verified job escrow for a QVAC/Hyperswarm inference network.
exercises: Sketch the Ed25519 quote that create_job expects.
not_covered: refund_job and rotate_peer_id were not exercised. payment_mint is SOL-only in this MVP.
build: Anchor 1.0.2 program, declared at 2R3iKnrn6aUBcb3SaPyJndwY7FoRJmooHH8QwjqJAgix on devnet.
student_outcome: Register or inspect an inference provider account and explain which registration fields the program stores.

learning_loop.objective: Predict what a provider registration writes — then inspect the provider account.
learning_loop.predict_question: A provider registers with a name and task-type bitmap. Where do those fields live after a successful registration?

predict_options.label: In the provider PDA/account owned by the marketplace program
Only as a memo on the registration transaction

learning_loop.predict_why: Marketplace registration creates/updates a provider account. Name and task-type bits are program state, not browser-only preferences.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/qvac-marketplace/ on Devnet. Register a practice provider or fetch an existing provider account from the lab proofs. Record the provider address and stored fields.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why is a successful wallet toast insufficient proof that the provider account holds the name you typed?
learning_loop.transfer: List the provider fields you would re-read on-chain before advertising the provider as registered.

assessment.purpose: Independent criteria for QVAC Marketplace elective: provider registration evidence.

criteria.title: Locates provider account
criteria.question: Can the student identify the provider PDA/account used by registration?
criteria.not_yet: Cannot name where provider state lives.
criteria.support: Finds it after a seeds/Explorer prompt.
criteria.independent: Records provider address and owner program from evidence.
criteria.misconception: Wallet address is the provider account.

criteria.title: Verifies stored registration fields
criteria.question: Can the student match name / task-type fields on-chain to the registration intent?
criteria.not_yet: Assumes UI success equals stored fields.
criteria.support: Checks account data after a prompt.
criteria.independent: Compares intended vs observed fields explicitly.

criteria.title: Honest evidence route
criteria.question: Does the student separate observation of lab proofs from a live registration?
criteria.independent: Marks observe vs live without coaching.
criteria.misconception: Lab wallet proof is my wallet’s completion.

criteria.title: Scopes claims to this lesson
criteria.question: Does the student avoid claiming full inference market mastery from registration alone?
criteria.independent: States what registration does and does not prove.
criteria.misconception: Registered provider means paid inference already worked.
